problem_text: Determine whether there exists a positive integer n for which g(n) > n^{0.999n}, where f(n), g(n) are the minimal positive integers such that 1 + 1/1! + 1/2! + ... + 1/n! = f(n)/g(n).
solution_text: We show that there does exist such a number n. Let epsilon = 10^{-10}. Call a prime p special, if for certain k in {1,2,...,p-1} there exist at least epsilon*k positive integers j <= k for which p divides f(j). Lemma: There exist only finitely many special primes. Proof: Let p be a special prime number, and p divides f(j) for at least epsilon*k values of j in {1,...,k}. Note that if p divides f(j), then using the recurrence for the partial sums of e, one can show that the values of j for which p|f(j) have a specific structure modulo p. This structure limits how many such j can exist, giving an upper bound that contradicts the specialness condition for large p. Hence only finitely many primes are special. For non-special primes p, p divides f(j) for at most epsilon*k values among j <= k. By choosing n as a product of sufficiently many non-special primes, the denominator g(n) retains most of the prime factors of n!, making g(n) > n^{0.999n}.
solution_summary: Define special primes (primes dividing f(j) for a positive fraction epsilon of j values). Prove only finitely many special primes exist using the modular structure of f(j). Then construct n using non-special primes so that g(n) retains most prime factors, achieving g(n) > n^{0.999n}.
answer: Yes, there exists a positive integer n for which g(n) > n^{0.999n}.
structure_features: 存在性问题——判断是否存在正整数n使g(n)（e的级数部分和的既约分母）超过n^{0.999n}。核心结构是分母的素因子保留率与指数下界的关系。

density_argument——用密度阈值epsilon区分素数行为

级数部分和的递推结构
key_insight: 定义特殊素数（以密度epsilon为阈值区分素数对f(j)的整除行为），证明只有有限个，从而非特殊素数足够多以构造g(n)大的n。

rounds.question: 这个问题的结构是什么？g(n)是什么？我们要判断什么存在性？
rounds.expected_answer: g(n)是S_n=sum_{k=0}^n 1/k!的既约分数分母，g(n)|n!。要判断是否存在n使g(n)>n^{0.999n}。这是一个存在性问题。

rounds.question: 列出所有可能的研究g(n)大小的方法方向
rounds.expected_answer: 直接计算g(n)小值；用n!的界；研究g(n)的素因子结构；研究哪些素数导致约分；概率方法；构造性方法

rounds.question: 试着用g(n)≤n!和Stirling公式来bound，看看能否解决
rounds.expected_answer: n!≈(n/e)^n，而n^{0.999n}/n!→0（因为0.001n·ln n增长快于n），所以g(n)≤n!不够紧，需要更精细的分析

rounds.question: g(n)什么时候会变小？约分发生在什么时候？从素数整除f(n)的角度思考
rounds.expected_answer: g(n)小是因为f(n)和g(n)有公因子，即素数p同时整除f(n)和n!。关键在于哪些素数p整除f(j)，导致约分使分母变小

rounds.question: 定义一个概念来区分经常整除f(j)和很少整除f(j)的素数，然后证明关于这个概念的引理
rounds.expected_answer: 定义epsilon=10^{-10}，p是特殊素数若存在k使至少epsilon*k个j≤k满足p|f(j)。引理：只有有限个特殊素数。证明利用f(j) mod p的递推结构

rounds.question: 有了有限个特殊素数的引理后，如何用非特殊素数构造n使g(n)大？
rounds.expected_answer: 对非特殊素数p，p在{1,...,k}中至多整除epsilon*k个f(j)，所以p在g(n)中保留的概率高。取n为大量非特殊素数的乘积，g(n)保留足够多素因子

rounds.question: 把所有部分组装起来，完成g(n)>n^{0.999n}的最终证明
rounds.expected_answer: 选择n为足够多非特殊素数的乘积，非特殊素数在g(n)中几乎全部保留，g(n)≈n!的足够大比例，超过n^{0.999n}。存在性得证
